records.body:

Ben

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: first project reached day 1 (2026-07-25), onboarding call held [calendar:587de2e1], and positive unprompted reply saying it's "starting to click" [email:e12b4ed8]. No tickets, no blockers. Against: no invite sent, Starter solo use, key_milestone still unreached after 6 days; 8 days left.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click — thanks for the update, and it was good talking on our call last week.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the usual next step is getting your team's real tasks into that project so it starts carrying actual work. When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that first batch of tasks with you — just say the word.

Best,
Chidi
